consent.mechanism: The E3 web consent (TB-W3-E3-01): a same-origin submission carrying a signed, expiring consent ticket bound to its purpose and to the session (issueWebConsentTicket, verifyWebConsentTicket, isSameOriginSubmission), decided server-side before any external call or write.

classes.COMPOSABLE: Target-bounded write a provisioning step may compose: exact organization or target, exact-head or exact-SHA guard, fail-closed governance, no free shell.
classes.OBSERVE: Read-only observation a step may use to prove existence, absence, health or a postcondition; missing evidence never proves absence.
classes.PROJECT_BOUND: Bounded to an allowlisted existing project: it never creates a new resource of its type and is never generalized implicitly into a provisioning primitive.
classes.SELF_MANAGEMENT: Operates the MCP runtime itself, which changes only through the Governed Deploy.
classes.DESTRUCTIVE: Deletes or empties content: never a provisioning step and never an automatic rollback.
classes.NOT_PROVISIONING: Coordination, review, authentication, transport or observation reserved to the controlled write mode: not a provisioning primitive.

steps.note: The server target is declared in .mcp/server-map.json by a reviewed pull request; the MCP picks it up only through its Governed Deploy.

The pre-state is proven on the host before any write: absence before extraction, or the stopped checkout of a created runtime. The rollback restores it, as the Governed Deploy keeps its previous image.

Exact revision fetched from GitHub, digest verified on S1, staged beside the target, compose file parsed against the reviewed keys before Compose loads it, model built from that file checked, then promoted with a marker: the project-bound bootstrap pattern behind the exact target and E3 consent.

Under its own consent: the revision is admitted again, the compose file of the unchanged checkout parsed and its model checked again, the services labelled, the compose project started and its health awaited. The Governed Deploy admission, wrapped for target runtimes.

On a failed health check the compose project stops without its volumes and the files the job created move to quarantine, nothing deleted: the pre-state is restored as the Governed Deploy restores the previous image.

rollback.detail: On a failed health check, restore the backup taken before the change, as the Governed Deploy restores the previous image; nothing outside the exact target is touched.
